summary: TotalEnergies SE filed a Form 6-K announcing the completion of its previously disclosed acquisition of 50% of EPH's flexible power generation platform in Western Europe. The transaction closed on April 29, 2026, after receiving all regulatory approvals; the Boards of both companies approved it. Consideration was ~95.4 million ordinary shares of TotalEnergies (~4.2% of share capital) issued to EPH, making EPH a major shareholder. The newly formed entity, TTEP, owns 14 GW of flexible generation assets across five European countries. The deal structure involves tolling contracts with TTEP. No break fee or premium was disclosed. Watch for TotalEnergies' stock price reaction to the equity issuance and EPH's potential further involvement.
